notesStmt.note: Horace Traubel's note on the reverse contains an obviously erroneous reference to April, 1888, well before Whitman began work on Complete Poems & Prose. In his notes from October 22, Traubel says that Whitman gave him "his original pencil design" of the title page, an apparent reference to the present document (see med.00002.100).
This is a preliminary sketch of the title page for Complete Poems & Prose, which Whitman self-published near the end of 1888.
